headline: On October 28, 2018: Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau Bridge opens
captionCards: HZMB: 55 km long, world's longest sea crossing
Reduced travel time, boosting regional integration
instagramCaption:
The world's longest sea crossing is now open! \\[The Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau Bridge (HZMB) opened for public traffic on October 24, 2018. This 55-kilometer bridge-tunnel system connects Hong Kong and Macau with Zhuhai, spanning the Lingding and Jiuzhou channels. It includes three cable-stayed bridges, an undersea tunnel, and four artificial islands. The HZMB is not just a feat of engineering but also a symbol of regional integration. Today, it significantly reduces travel time between these key cities, boosting economic and social ties. \\[What do you think about this massive infrastructure project? \\[Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
